steam.en: Stick Fight is a physics-based couch/online fighting game where you battle it out as the iconic stick figures from the golden age of the internet.

de.text: Stick Fight: The Game ist ein Ragdoll-Fighting-Game aus dem Jahr 2017.

en.text: Stick Fight: The Game is an action fighting multiplayer-only video game developed and published by Landfall Games on Steam on September 28, 2017. Later, the game was ported to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox and Android.
